capabilities: Chat with multiple local CLI agents and switch between them and models
Attach vault files and convert PDF, Word, and Excel documents to Markdown
Inspect streaming responses, reasoning blocks, and tool input/output payloads
Manage multiple chat sessions with context bars and token/cost statistics
Trigger agents and prompt templates through slash commands and file mentions
extras: Detailed privacy section: chat history stored in plain text in data.json and may be synced with the vault; hosted OCR via Firecrawl Parse is off by default; auto-approve lets agents run shell commands and edit files without confirmation and is disabled by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run AI CLI agents against notes, so users must switch to a terminal to work with agents on their vault.

relations.evidence: connects local AI CLI agents (Antigravity, OpenCode, Hermes Agent, and Pi) directly to your vault
relations.plugin: Antigravity, OpenCode, Hermes Agent, Pi Coding Agent

relations.evidence: Optional automatic conversion of PDF, Word, and Excel attachments to Markdown via anydoc
scanned documents are uploaded to the external Firecrawl Parse service

requires.name: at least one supported agent CLI (agy, opencode, hermes, or pi) on PATH, plus sqlite3
Google AI Pro subscription for Antigravity

summary: Desktop plugin that connects local AI CLI agents to the vault for chatting, analyzing notes, attaching files, and inspecting tool calls.
